왼쪽.x: The restroom is on the left.

꽃.x: In spring, lots of flowers bloom in the park.
꽃.e: 꽃집 = flower shop; 꽃미남 = 'flower boy', a pretty-faced guy.
꽃.t: Pronounced [꼳] alone, but the ㅊ returns before a vowel: 꽃이 [꼬치], 꽃을 [꼬츨].

놓다.m: to put, to place, to set down
놓다.x: Please put your bag on the chair.
놓다.e: Put down; 놓고 오다 = to leave something behind.

끓이다.m: to boil (something); to make (soup, stew, ramen)
끓이다.x: After boiling the water, add the ramen.
끓이다.e: 끓다 'to boil' + causative -이-: 'to make something boil'.
끓이다.t: Pronounced [끄리다] — the ㅎ is silent before a vowel.

붓다.forms: 부어요 · 부었어요 · 부을 거예요 · 부으세요 (ㅅ irregular)
붓다.x: Pour two cups of water into the pot.
붓다.e: Homonym warning: 붓다 also means 'to swell', as in 얼굴이 부었어요 'my face is puffy'.
붓다.t: For pouring a drink into a glass, Koreans usually say 따르다: 술을 따르다.

붓다.forms: 부어요 · 부었어요 · 부을 거예요 · 부은 (+noun) (ㅅ irregular)
붓다.ex: 어젯밤에 라면을 먹고 자서 얼굴이 부었어요.
붓다.x: I ate ramyeon before bed last night, so my face is puffy.
붓다.e: Homonym: 붓다 also means 'to pour,' as in 물을 붓다, conjugated the same way.
붓다.t: Swelling is a result, so use the past form for a current state: 발이 부었어요, 'my feet are swollen.'

다행히.forms: 다행히 + clause; 다행이에요 = What a relief
다행히.ex: 다행히 비가 그쳐서 소풍을 갈 수 있었어요.
다행히.x: Fortunately, the rain stopped, so we could go on the picnic.
다행히.t: 다행이다! (What a relief!) is a very common reaction on its own.

세상.x: I love my mom more than anyone in the world.
세상.e: Literally 'upon the world' — the world we live in.

구성되다.m: to consist of, to be made up of, to be composed of
구성되다.ex: 우리 팀은 다섯 명으로 구성되어 있어요.
구성되다.x: Our team is made up of five people.
구성되다.t: Pattern: N(으)로 구성되어 있다 'to consist of N'.

이동하다.m: to move, to go (to another place)
이동하다.x: For the next class, please move to the third-floor classroom.
이동하다.t: 이동하다 means changing location; for moving to a new home, use 이사하다.

자연스럽다.x: That actor's acting is really natural.
자연스럽다.t: 자연스럽게 is the adverb: 자연스럽게 말해요 'speak naturally'.

어흥.x: At the zoo, the tiger let out a roar.
어흥.e: 의성어 (sound word) imitating a tiger's roar.
어흥.t: Parents shout 어흥! playfully to 'scare' small children, like English 'Rawr!'.

도박.ex: 그 사람은 도박으로 돈을 모두 잃었어요.
도박.x: He lost all his money gambling.

구속.ex: 그 정치인은 조사를 받은 후 결국 구속되었습니다.
구속.x: After being questioned, that politician was eventually taken into custody.
구속.t: In the news 구속 means being held in custody; in daily life it means restricting freedom (자유를 구속하다).

열등감.ex: 그는 형에 대해 열등감을 가지고 있어요.
열등감.x: He has an inferiority complex about his older brother.
열등감.e: Literally 'the feeling of being lower in rank'.
열등감.t: Pronounced [열뜽감] — ㄷ becomes tense after ㄹ in Sino-Korean words.

독립적.x: My older sister has lived independently since college.
독립적.t: Pronounced [동닙쩍] — nasalization: ㄱ + ㄹ becomes ㅇ + ㄴ.

지향하다.m: to aim for, to pursue, to be oriented toward
지향하다.ex: 우리 회사는 고객 중심의 서비스를 지향합니다.
지향하다.x: Our company aims for customer-centered service.
지향하다.t: Don't confuse with 지양하다 (to avoid), which sounds similar but means the opposite.

어깨가 무겁다.m: to feel a heavy responsibility, to feel the pressure
어깨가 무겁다.x: Now that I'm the new team leader, I feel the weight of responsibility.
어깨가 무겁다.e: Responsibility pictured as a load on your shoulders, much like in English.

진정.forms: 진정 + verb/adjective · as modifier: 진정한 + noun
진정.ex: 진정 원하는 것이 무엇인지 생각해 보세요.
진정.x: Think about what you truly want.
진정.t: Don't confuse it with 진정하다 'to calm down', a different word: 진정하세요! 'Calm down!'

실익.ex: 이번 협상에서 우리가 얻은 실익은 크지 않았습니다.
실익.x: The real gains we got from this negotiation were not large.
실익.e: Literally 'real benefit', as opposed to just name or appearance.
실익.t: Often contrasted with 명분: 명분보다 실익 = real gains over appearances.

전압.x: The household voltage used in Korea is usually 220 volts.

면접시험.m: interview (as part of an exam or hiring), oral interview test
면접시험.x: I have a company interview tomorrow morning.

요양원.ex: 아버지는 은퇴 후 요양원에서 봉사 활동을 하세요.
요양원.x: After retiring, my father volunteers at a nursing home.
요양원.t: 요양원 offers long-term care; 요양병원 is a hospital with doctors on staff for elderly patients.

단체교섭.ex: 노조는 임금 인상을 위해 회사와 단체교섭을 시작했습니다.
단체교섭.x: The union began collective bargaining with the company for a wage increase.

평화협정.x: There are discussions about replacing the armistice with a peace treaty.

신경외과.x: I go to neurosurgery for my herniated disc.
신경외과.e: Literally 'nerve surgery department'; -과 = hospital department: 내과, 안과.
신경외과.t: Pronounced [신경외꽈]; 신경과 treats nerves with medicine, while 신경외과 operates.

문상.m: condolence call, paying respects to the bereaved
문상.ex: 회사 동료의 아버지가 돌아가셔서 문상을 다녀왔어요.
문상.x: A coworker's father passed away, so I went to pay my respects.
문상.e: Literally 'visiting the mourning' — calling on a grieving family.
문상.t: Common phrase: 문상을 가다. 조문 means nearly the same and is more common in news.

반증하다.m: to disprove, to refute; to show (indirectly), to be a sign of
반증하다.ex: 새로운 실험 결과가 기존 이론을 반증했습니다.
반증하다.x: The new experimental results disproved the existing theory.
반증하다.t: In news, 이는 ~을 반증한다 often means 'this shows (indirectly) that…', not just 'disproves.'

전용하다.m: to divert (funds or land) to another use, to repurpose
전용하다.ex: 예산을 다른 곳에 전용한 것이 감사에서 적발됐습니다.
전용하다.x: The audit caught that the budget had been diverted elsewhere.
전용하다.e: Literally 'shift the use' — moving money or land to a purpose not intended.
전용하다.t: Don't confuse with 전용 專用 'exclusive use', as in 버스 전용 차로 'bus-only lane'.

문제의식.m: awareness of an issue, critical sense of a problem
문제의식.x: This research started from a clear awareness of the problem.
문제의식.t: Collocation: 문제의식을 가지다/느끼다 'to see something as a real problem'.

후생가외.m: the younger generation deserves respect, juniors may surpass their elders
후생가외.x: They say juniors may surpass us — the new employee's skills are amazing.
후생가외.e: From Confucius: those born after us deserve awe, for they may surpass us.
